Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection, likely cystitis or pyelonephritis. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy. No evidence of ketonuria or casts.
